mentions.name: pyc
mentions.description: This compiler for Python 3.14.x generates static code, enabling Python programs to be deployed without exporting the entire environment or building a container. It is early stage and still a work in progress.
mentions.problem: Deploying Python code currently requires either exporting the entire environment or building a container; the latter is not possible in a number of deployment cases, and the former carries dependency radius gotchas.
mentions.source_excerpt: pyc is a work in progress.

evidence.value: pyc is a work in progress.
